arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
p = 'threads.py'
src = open(p).read()
src = src.replace("proc.stdin.write(data)\nproc.stdin.close()",
                  "proc.stdin.write(data)\nproc.stdin.close()\nproc.wait()")
src = src.replace("out = proc.stdout.read()", "out = proc.stdout.read()\nrc = proc.returncode")
src = src.replace("% (max_threads, max_fds, proc.returncode, len(out.splitlines())))",
                  "% (max_threads, max_fds, rc, len(out.splitlines())))")
open(p, 'w').write(src)
EOF
python3 threads.py
